title: It’s a Thin Line Between Love and Hate: Using the Echo in Modeling Dynamics of Racist Online Communities
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational detection and analysis of antisemitic and racist hate speech in online communities. It specifically evaluates how religious and ethnic identities (particularly Jewish and Muslim) are targeted through memes and linguistic variations, making it a study centered on digital ethics and the evaluation of moral/social harm against faith-based and minority groups.
